AboutText: A fast, free and customizable file manager for Windows.
AccentDesc: Used for selection, active pane, switches and buttons. The first one follows Windows.
AddFolderTip: Add a folder to the sidebar (or just drag one here)
AddTip: Add a folder, app, header or separator (or drag folders and apps here)
ArchiveBigFile: Large file inside an archive – open it to see it.
ArchiveOpenWithDesc: Right-click an archive anywhere in Windows › Open in WinXplorer (Windows 11: Show more options) or Open with › WinXplorer. Your default app is not changed.
ArchiveReadOnly: Archives are read-only here – extract the files to change them.
CodecHeic: HEIC photos (iPhone, Samsung) – needs HEIF Image Extensions and HEVC Video Extensions from Device Manufacturer
CodecJxl: JPEG XL – needs JPEG XL Image Extension
CodecMissing: This PC has no decoder for {0} yet. Windows reads it with a free extension from Microsoft Store:
CodecRaw: camera RAW – needs Raw Image Extension
CommandPrompt: Program and parameters. %1 = the selected item, %* = all selected, %d = the current folder. Example: code "%1"
ConfirmDeleteDesc: Del moves to the Recycle Bin (Ctrl+Z puts it back), Shift+Del deletes permanently and always asks.
ConfirmDeletePermanent:
Permanently delete {0}?
This can't be undone.
CropFailed: The picture could not be saved.
Cropped: "{0}" cropped – the original is in the Recycle Bin
CustomIconsDesc: Put css.svg (and css-small.svg for lists) into {0} to replace any icon.
DblClickViewerDesc: Double-click or Enter on a picture opens the built-in viewer instead of the default app.
DefaultFM: WinXplorer opens folders (instead of Windows Explorer)
DefaultFMDesc: Double-click on folders and drives, folder links and Win+E open WinXplorer. While WinXplorer runs, folders other programs open straight in Explorer (torrent clients, a browser's Show in folder) move over too. Desktop, taskbar, Control Panel and Recycle Bin stay with Windows. Switch off to make Windows Explorer the default again.
DocTextOnly: Text only (no Word previewer on this PC)
DonateDesc: No ads, no tracking. If it helps you, you can support development with a coffee.
DonateTip: WinXplorer is free. Buy me a coffee ☕
FastSearchDesc: Remembers the names of all files on your drives (in the background, low priority) so search finds them instantly as you type. Uses about 50 MB per million files; nothing leaves your PC.
FrequentFoldersDesc: A block in the sidebar with the folders you open most, updated as you browse (right-click one to forget it).
HeaderPrompt: Title of the group (empty = plain separator):
HelpIntro: Everything WinXplorer can do from the keyboard, and a few tips for the less obvious features.
HkAddress: Type a path in the address bar
HkColumn: Column selection – type to change every line
HkDeleteImage: Move the picture to the Recycle Bin
HkEditHint: Click a key to change it, right-click to remove it, + adds another combination. Esc cancels.
HkKeyTip: Click to change · right-click to remove
HkMarquee: Select with a rectangle (Ctrl: add to the selection)
HkMiddleClick: Open a folder in a new tab
HkOtherPane: Switch to the other pane (split view)
HkQuickView: Quick view (pictures, text, code, PDF, Office, video…)
HkRename: Rename – several selected: rename them all as text
HkUndo: Undo the last rename, move, copy or delete
HoverAutoPlay: Play video and audio on hover
HoverAutoPlayDesc: In the hover preview, video and audio start playing at once.
HoverPreviewDesc: Rest the mouse on a file or folder for a second: a small preview opens beside it – pictures, video, audio, documents, text, archive and folder contents.
IndexSkipWindowsDesc: C:\Windows holds hundreds of thousands of system files; leaving it out keeps the index small. Searching inside it still works (slower).
IndexTruncated: first {0} shown – type more to narrow
InvalidName: The name contains characters that are not allowed:  \ / : * ? " < > |
Label: Label
LanguageDesc: Automatic follows the Windows display language. The new language is used after a restart.
MediaNoFeaturePack: This Windows edition ("N") has no media components. Install the free "Media Feature Pack" in Settings › System › Optional features, then restart the PC.
MediaNoWmp: Video and audio need Windows Media Player (Legacy), which isn't installed on this PC. Add it in Settings › System › Optional features › "Windows Media Player Legacy" (free, a minute), then restart WinXplorer.
MediaUnsupported: Windows' player can't play this format – open it with your media player.
MenuAddCustomDesc: Run any program on the selection – e.g. VS Code, Photoshop, a script. "Open with an app…" lists your programs; in a command, Browse… picks any .exe and you type the name the menu shows. The icon comes from the program.
MenuAddWindowsDesc: Everything Windows and installed programs add (7-Zip, Send to, Edit with…). Shown only where Windows offers it.
MenuAllAdded: Everything is already in the menu.
MenuEditorHint: Drag rows to reorder, untick to hide. Items that don't apply (e.g. Extract for a non-zip) are hidden automatically.
MenuLoadWindows: Load items from the Windows menu
MenuModeDesc: For every menu you haven't built in the menu builder: WinXplorer's short menu or the full classic Windows menu with all extensions. Shift+right-click always opens the full Windows menu.
NewFilesChosen: In the New menu, in this order (drag or use the arrows)
NewFilesDesc: Choose which file types appear under New (toolbar and right-click on empty space). New files get a small starter template (HTML page, Python main…).
NewTip: Create a new folder or file
NoCodec: No preview available. For HEIC/AVIF/RAW install the free codec from Microsoft Store.
NoResults:
No items match your search.
Press Enter to search all subfolders.
NotResponding: This location is not responding (an offline network drive?). Press Refresh to try again.
OpenArchivesDesc: In WinXplorer: double-click browses the archive here, with the archive icon; drag files out or right-click › Extract. Default program: 7-Zip, WinRAR or whatever Windows uses for the type.
OpenViewerTip: Click to open the image viewer · wheel zooms, drag moves
OwnCodeIconsDesc: HTML, CSS, JS, PHP, Python… get a coloured icon with the extension. Files Windows has no icon for always get one.
PasteTip: Paste (Ctrl+V) – also pastes screenshots as PNG
QuickRowDesc: The first line of the menu: icons only, one click each. Commands placed here are not repeated in the list below; ones that don't apply stay greyed out.
QuickRowEmpty: Empty – the menu starts with the list.
Recycled: Moved {0} to the Recycle Bin – Ctrl+Z to undo
RenExists: Line {0}: "{1}" already exists in this folder
RenFailed: Some items could not be renamed:
RenInvalid: Line {0}: the name is empty or has characters that are not allowed (\ / : * ? " < > |)
RenLineCount: There are {0} lines – need {1}, one for each item
RenameLabelPrompt: Name shown in the sidebar (empty = folder name):
RenameManyHint: One name per line, in the same order as the current names on the left. Column selection: Alt + drag or drag with the mouse wheel button (or Alt+Shift+arrows) – typing then changes every selected line at once.
ResetSidebarDesc: Desktop, Downloads, drives, Documents and Screenshots.
RestoreTabsDesc: Open the same tabs and split views as last time.
SelectToPreview: Select a file to see its preview and details.
ShowFolderSizesDesc: The size column counts what every folder holds – in the background, folder by folder. Uses more disk activity; network folders are skipped.
SidebarHowDesc: Drag folders into the sidebar to pin them, drag entries to reorder them, right-click an entry to rename, remove or hide it.
SpaceViewerDesc: Space shows the selected file – pictures, text and code, video, PDF and Office documents – Space again closes it.
SysEditionN: This is an "N" edition: it comes without media components – video and audio need the free Media Feature Pack (see below).
SysHeifMissing: libheif.dll is missing next to WinXplorer.exe – reinstall WinXplorer.
SysHeifOk: Built into WinXplorer – no codec needed.
SysHevc: H.265 videos (iPhone, newer phones and cameras). Many PCs have it preinstalled ("from Device Manufacturer", free).
SysIntro: What WinXplorer uses from Windows, checked on this PC. If something plays or opens in other apps but not here, the reason is usually listed below – with a button to fix it.
SysMfOk: Windows' media engine – needed for all video and audio.
SysOff: Off – folders open in Windows Explorer (Settings › General).
SysOfficeMissing: No Office previewers (Office not installed): Word documents show as text, others as their icon.
SysOfficeOk: Office previewers are installed: documents show as they look.
SysOn: On – folders open in WinXplorer (Settings › General).
SysPdfOk: First page shown sharp with Windows' own PDF engine (also Illustrator .ai).
SysPdfPages: PDF previewer (all pages in quick view)
SysPdfPagesMissing: No PDF previewer registered: quick view shows the first page only.
SysPdfPagesOk: A PDF previewer is installed (Edge, Acrobat…): quick view shows every page.
SysRaw: Camera RAW photos (DNG, CR2, NEF, ARW…).
SysWmpOk: WinXplorer plays video and audio through it. Other players (e.g. Media Player) don't need it – that's why a file can play there but not here.
ThemeDesc: Light or dark, or the same as Windows.
TipArchives: Double-click opens an archive like a folder. Drag files out of it, or right-click › Extract. To pack: select files › right-click › Compress to ZIP. Space shows what's inside.
TipCrop: In the picture viewer press X (or the crop button), drag a rectangle – move it or pull its edges – and press Enter. "Crop" replaces the file (the original goes to the Recycle Bin), "Save as copy" keeps both.
TipQuick: Space on any file: pictures open in the viewer, everything else in a quick view – text and code you can select and copy, PDF and Office through Windows' previewers, video and audio with sound control, programs show their details. Space again closes it.
TipRename: Select the files and press F2: the names open as text, one per line. Edit them like in a code editor, use Find › Replace (with regex), and fix the pink lines – they would clash.
TipSearch: Type in the search box: the folder filters as you type, and from 2 letters every subfolder is searched (the whole drive from its root). * and ? work as wildcards.
TipSplit: Use the split buttons in the toolbar to see two folders at once and drag files between them. F6 switches between the two panes.
UndoNotFound: the item is no longer in the Recycle Bin
ViewForAll: Use this view for all folders
ViewForAllDone: This view is now the default for every folder
VideoNoCodec: The video plays only as sound – Windows lacks the codec for its picture.
SearchSyntaxTip:
Search filters:
photo  –  name contains “photo”
*.png  –  wildcards: * any text, ? one character
^Icons  –  case-sensitive
"Icons"  –  exact name (with or without extension)
*.png|*.jpg  –  either one
*.log -old  –  leave out names containing “old”
/^IMG_\d+/  –  regular expression
With the drive index ready, all subfolders are searched.
ZipStopAsk: Stop compressing? The unfinished archive will be deleted.
ZipOpenFolder: Open folder in a new window
PinBlocked: Windows doesn't allow this from other apps – pin it from the Start menu (right-click the app)
NavOnTopDesc: One address bar and search for the active pane, above the command bar – like Windows Explorer. Off: every pane has its own.
MenuAltNote: A second menu: hold Ctrl and right-click files or folders. (Shift + right-click opens the Windows menu.)
MenuTypeGeneral: {0} use the menu for all items. Change anything below and {0} get their own menu.
MenuUseGeneral: Use the menu for all items
CmdFlagsHint: Browser flags (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox). A separate profile keeps its own cookies and logins.
NewTabThisPCDesc: Off: a new tab (Ctrl+T, +) opens the folder you are in.
TargetMissing: The shortcut's target no longer exists
SubmenuHint: Drag commands between the submenu and its end mark – they are shown inside it.
CmdProgramHint: Choose an installed app, or Browse… for any .exe. The menu shows the program's own icon.
MenuBuilderDesc: Build menus by dragging – files, folders, images, video, audio, the Ctrl menu, the folder background – with the icon row on top. Only the menus you build change; the others keep the style above.
BuilderAppsDesc: Programs you picked and your own commands – drag them into a menu.
BuilderNoApps: None yet – add an app below.
BuilderHint: Drag a command from the left into a menu. Dropped on the top row it becomes an icon (up to 8: 5 large, 6 medium, 8 small). Drag inside a menu to reorder, into another menu to copy. Only built menus are used – empty ones keep the menu style from Settings (an empty kind uses the Files menu if you built that one).
BuilderRowSlot: Icon row: drop a command here
BuilderDiscard: Close the builder and discard what you changed?
BuilderApplyNote: Nothing changes until you click Apply. Your apps and commands are saved at once.
MenuModeDescAll: All menus are built in the menu builder, so these styles aren't used. Shift+right-click still opens the full Windows menu.
MenuFullNone: Fully custom: none yet – build a menu in the builder below.
BuilderFixed: Always at the end of every menu
